templates.name: general_modern
templates.label: General Modern
templates.description: A balanced modern SVG deck style for general business, technology sharing, and narrative reports.
templates.layout_guidance: Use clear title hierarchy, restrained cards, generous margins, and varied layouts across pages.

templates.name: mckinsey
templates.label: McKinsey Style
templates.description: A restrained consulting style for strategy, investment analysis, executive briefings, and data-driven recommendations.
templates.layout_guidance: Use a thin top blue rule, left-aligned titles, strong grids, whitespace, concise takeaway statements, and editable charts or matrices where relevant.

templates.name: ai_ops
templates.label: Enterprise Digital Intelligence
templates.description: A dense enterprise architecture style for AI operations, telecom, system overviews, and digital transformation plans.
templates.layout_guidance: Use compact modular zones, red title anchors, blue label bars, warm gray panels, KPI cards, and dense but aligned information blocks.

templates.name: academic_blue
templates.label: Academic Blue
templates.description: A structured academic style for research reports, defense decks, papers, and project proposals.
templates.font_family: Microsoft YaHei, Times New Roman, Arial, sans-serif
templates.layout_guidance: Use explicit section hierarchy, evidence-first layouts, diagrams, figure captions, and restrained academic blue accents.

templates.name: government_blue
templates.label: Government Blue
templates.description: A stable official-report style for smart governance, public-sector reports, and policy briefings.
templates.layout_guidance: Use formal title bands, clear policy modules, stable blue accents, concise bullet groups, and official report spacing.
